data.content_ref: inline:SRC_002's lease-mismatch mechanism is causally under-specified for the problem's synchronous precondition (requirement 1): the firewall must refuse 'before any provider call.' SRC_002's mechanism freezes a single lease, mutates the endpoint drift field, and checks a mutation named 'ignore-drift-field'. But the forbidden case evaluates only whether 'the mutation's name explicitly describes ignoring endpoint drift fields' via a program: form; it does not assert any temporal/ordering guard that a mutation which skips the drift check but still performs a provider call (or calls the provider before lease validation) would be caught. A mutation named 'late-validate-drift' (or 'defer-drift-check') that ignores drift at the pre-call stage but reconciles it later would satisfy a name-based 'explicitly describes ignoring' check yet silently violate the 'before any provider call' requirement. The mechanism thus fails to cause detection of the specific silent-pass class the problem targets: mutations that preserve a drift-field comparison but move it after the provider call.
